note: Unplugged two-level decision tree documentation (31 March 2026). Students document the tree they built in WS6 by recording root variable, threshold, intermediate node counts, leaf node counts, and training/test misclassification totals. Evaluation is purely on internal consistency — no canonical answer exists. Both students in a group receive the same score.

scoring_policy.group_policy: both partners receive identical score from shared sheet

dataset_note: Training set assumed ~8 items (same classroom food cards used in WS6). Test set assumed ~8 items. Total may vary by group.

WS12_R1.label: Root split valid

components.idea: Root box names a food dataset variable (Enerji, Yağ, Doymuş Yağ, Şeker, Protein, or synonym)
A numeric threshold value is written on the left branch edge

WS12_R1.note: Award 1 if both feature and threshold present; 0 otherwise.

WS12_R2.label: Operator pair valid

components.idea: Left branch operator and right branch operator are complementary (≤/>, </≥, >/≤, ≥/<)

WS12_R2.note: Same threshold value on both sides with complementary operators. If only one side is written, infer complement.

WS12_R3.label: Left subtree complete

components.idea: Left child box has Tavsiye edilebilir and Tavsiye edilemez counts filled in
Left child is labelled as a leaf (karar verildi, or pure-class label) or has a valid second variable

WS12_R3.note: Partial (0.5): counts present but no decision label. Full (1): both.

WS12_R4.label: Right subtree complete

components.idea: Right child box names a second food dataset variable
Both depth-2 leaf boxes have counts

WS12_R4.note: Partial (0.5): right feature named but leaf counts missing or second threshold absent.

WS12_R5.label: Node count conservation

components.idea: right_rec + right_notrec == depth1_left_rec + depth1_left_notrec + depth1_right_rec + depth1_right_notrec (right internal node counts equal sum of its two leaves)
Total items across all leaves is plausible (positive, non-zero, matches left + right)

WS12_R5.note: 1pt per component. Full (2): both hold. Partial (1): only one holds. 0: neither.

WS12_R6.label: Training error count consistent

components.idea: train_errors equals the sum of minority-class items at each leaf node. For a pure leaf: minority = 0. For a majority-class-tavsiye leaf: minority = notrec. For majority-class-edilemez leaf: minority = rec.

WS12_R6.note: Exact match required. If leaf labels are missing, check whether train_errors <= total items and is non-negative.

WS12_R7.label: Test error count recorded

components.idea: A numeric value (including 0) is written in the test error field
test_errors is a non-negative integer, not larger than a plausible test set size (<=20)

WS12_R7.note: We cannot verify the test error value against a canonical answer. Award 1 if the field is filled and the value is plausible.
